rules.title: CI selection misses tracked direct inputs

Seven committed seeds establish bounded correctness, with two warning groups covering three missing-input edges, two supported negatives and three intentional abstentions. Paired measurements also found material warm-path overhead. Three independent final votes defer shipping until representative real graph coverage and a performance budget are demonstrated. Preserve the tested prototype and immutable evidence.
